package.name: f1tenth_bringup
package.description: Top-level launch package for the F1TENTH car. Combines the launch files of every subsystem package (driver stack, joystick/teleop, sensors, ...) into one bringup launch file. To add a new subsystem, add its package as an exec_depend below and add one IncludeLaunchDescription block in launch/bringup_launch.py.
